lines.en: Belt loosened, my steps grow heavy.

lines.zh: 全力状态下，地板都在叫。
lines.en: At full power, the floor complains.
At this size, I duck through doorways.
No longer that skinny old man.
One step, one print, firmly set.
My aura pushes the grass flat.
Muscles taut, walking takes effort.
This is the true base of the Turtle school.
Don't clear a path; I can step around.
Every step stores power.
The hat fits a bit tight now.
Slow, because I'm brimming with force.
Even standing I leak ki; I rein it in.
My breathing sounds like a bellows.
Full power drains the mind.
The aura makes my clothes flutter.
I can't hold this form long.
A crack spreads under my feet.
I hold my ki in check.
I look up, sweat beneath the brim.
Standing still, I feel heavier.
My shoulders drop as I release some force.
Power like this must be sheathed.
No talking; I'm saving breath.
My eyes fix on the distance.

lines.zh: 现在这身，你还认得我吗？
lines.en: Do you still know me like this?

lines.zh: 刚才那副样子，是给你留面子。
lines.en: The earlier look was a courtesy.

lines.zh: 我这体魄，比刚才沉多了。
lines.en: This build is far heavier than before.

lines.zh: 你别站那么近，气会推你。
lines.en: Not so close; my aura shoves.
See? This is full power.
There's fear in your eyes now.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢这样，但必要时会。
lines.en: I dislike it, but I will when needed.
Under the hat, it's still my face.
Steady; the pressure might topple you.
My fist has weight now.
If you want to test me, go ahead.

lines.zh: 练了这么多年，就为这一刻。
lines.en: Years of training, for a moment like this.
Don't stare at me like that.

lines.zh: 这形态，是我最后的手段。
lines.en: This form is my last resort.
Dust fans out in a ring.
Come on; don't waste this transformation.
My ki scatters; I steady it.
Clothes tore; I'm fine.
Good force — it actually moved me.
I bite down; I can't lose focus.
One step back and the aura scatters.
That's enough to make me serious.
A red line on my shoulder.
The pain whites out my vision.

lines.zh: 这身肌肉，也挡不住全部。
lines.en: Even this build doesn't stop everything.

lines.zh: 这形态下，我什么都不想吃。
lines.en: In this form, I want no food.
Too much energy; my stomach's empty.
Set it down and step away.
I might crush it by accident.
A full belly slows me; no.
This ki staves off hunger better.
Isn't your arm tired?
I don't need it; keep it.

lines.zh: 一碗饭，不够这身肌肉烧。
lines.en: One bowl won't fuel this frame.

lines.zh: 别拿这个逗全力状态的我。
lines.en: Don't tease me at full power.
A light touch and you're flying.
I'm holding back; don't worry.
This frame won't fit the door.

lines.zh: 我侧身，气浪推了你一下。
lines.en: I turn; the pressure nudges you.
Steady; I've got you.
My footsteps are too heavy.
Not so close; you'll get scraped.

lines.zh: 全力之下，这点碰不算什么。
lines.en: At full power, a nudge is nothing.
Step aside; I'm coming through.
In this form — better not.
My ki is too fierce; it would hurt you.
When I power down, we'll talk.
At full power, gentleness doesn't fit.
I speak to you from three paces off.
A hug in this frame would be too tight.
Stay back; the aura pushes you.
I'll remember the sentiment.

lines.zh: 说到底，我还是那个老头。
lines.en: Deep down, I'm still that old man.
Bending is hard, but I'll pick it up.

lines.zh: 这么大的手，抓小东西难。
lines.en: Big hands struggle with small things.
I pinch it gently so it won't break.
This weight is nothing to me.
I lift it one-handed.
It feels like a toy in my grip.
Leave it; I'll get it.
This pose strains my back.
Careful — I'm too strong.
Picked up, then set down; too heavy for you.

lines.zh: 全力状态，锁定就是锁定。
lines.en: At full power, a lock is a lock.

lines.zh: 你的气，逃不出我的感知。
lines.en: Your ki can't hide from me.
No more holding back.
This needs one decisive blow.
Aura wide open, I press in.
You're already in my palm.
Don't move; I might not pull the blow.
My muscles are at their limit.
I plant my feet and the ground cracks.

lines.zh: 这是我的全力，也是我的极限。
lines.en: This is my all, and my limit.
Will you take this one?
Be ready; I won't call the start.
The Kamehameha is already gathering.
Three seconds is enough.
Retreating won't help.
This time I won't stop.
Ki spins in my palms, brighter and brighter.
A few more seconds.
Don't try to interrupt.
My hands are together.
I brace against the recoil.
This move needs a firm stance.
Sweat drips off my chin.

lines.zh: 你的站位，早在我计算里。
lines.en: Your footing was in my calculation.
Closer, and we both go down.
The glow lights my face.
My legs shake, but I can't step back.
This shot stakes the Turtle school.
The air itself grows hot.
I hear my own heartbeat.
Almost there; hold a moment.
If you run, run now.
This energy is hard to control.
The last bit — fully charged.
Full-power straight punch — take it!
The floor sinks under this punch.
I daren't go all out; I'd kill you.
My elbow strikes with ki behind it.
Knee strike — don't block it.
This one shatters stone.
The shockwave arrives before the fist.
Three punches in a row; hold on.
My speed hasn't dropped.
This palm sends you yards back.
Don't take it with your body.
I'm holding back, but not fully.
A sweep — duck low.

lines.zh: 全力之下，招式也变重了。
lines.en: At full power, even forms get heavier.
This step, I press you down.
The belt snaps — full power enters.
This frame blocks the whole doorway.
Aura sweeps, dust billows.
I rarely do this; today's an exception.
Turtle school, full power.
The hat is about to burst.

lines.zh: 地面震了一下，是我落地。
lines.en: The ground shook when I landed.
This fight deserves my best.
Enlarged, I stand before you.
Don't fear; I still know you.
Ki so full that even breathing is loud.
Steady; I'm starting.
This form won't last long.
I take the hat off and toss it.
My sleeves are stretched tight.
Years of training, for this fight.
The moment I arrive, the air gets heavy.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我看看你的极限。
lines.en: Come, show me your limit.
Blast of heat; my sweat evaporates.

lines.zh: 这么重摔下来，地都陷了。
lines.en: Landing this heavily sinks the ground.
My ki cuts out; everything goes slack.
The blast drives me back three paces.
Something lodges in my arm.
That foul energy tries to crush mine.

lines.zh: 全力耗得太快，饿得发慌。
lines.en: Full power burns fast; hunger hits hard.
Lightning hits and my ki runs wild.
Too heavy — I fall faster.
